verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions vision-language-action models, robotics foundation models, or any supported tooling for plugging such policies into the autonomy stack. Viam documents generic bring-your-own-model ML deployment with local inference, a vision service for detection, classification and segmentation, and logic modules that coordinate a camera and an arm. These are adjacent building blocks a developer could use to construct such an integration, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can integrate vision-language-action or robotics foundation models into my robot's autonomy stack through supported tooling
